subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add a public staged compaction event and diagnostics contract for WebChat/Gateway, and what compaction details are safe to expose?
rationale: The missing visibility is source-provable, but fixing it adds public protocol/API or CLI surface, redaction policy, and a boundary decision between core diagnostics and context-engine plugin guidance.

options.title: Narrow core observability contract
options.body: Extend existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, completion, and failure metadata while documenting running-summary behavior as a context-engine plugin pattern.

options.title: Docs and current notices only
options.body: Keep notifyUser, compaction-notifier, generic stability diagnostics, and basic start/end indicators as the supported path, then improve discoverability through docs.

options.title: Dedicated compaction diagnostics API
options.body: Add a new compaction-specific Gateway RPC or CLI with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow core observability contract
recommendation.body: Extend existing compact operation and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage, timing, completion, and failure metadata while documenting running-summary behavior as a context-engine plugin pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest current-main ownership signal for the WebChat compaction progress surface that would need the protocol/UI direction decision.
